item.tib: bla ma rig 'dzin 'dus pa las slob ma rig pa rtsal dbang
item.coloph: ces pa rig 'dzin gsang bsgrub (sgrub) kyi dbang mchog (chog) 'di ni sna chen brag dkar gter du drangs shing / phyis su dus bab kyi rten 'brelaM gyi thog mar/ rigs ldan mkha' 'gro dbang mo dang mchog spral g.yung drung gnyis kyi (kyis) bskul ngor/ gsang sngags gling pas rang dgon g.yung drung mthong smon gling du bris pas/ 'gro kun rig 'dzin mchog gi go 'phang thob pa'i rgyu ru gyur cig/
